summary: Insight English is a language school with branches in Silom, Lad Prao and Hua Hin teaching English, exam preparation and Thai, with Thai or English education visa courses.

facts.label: ED visa
facts.value: Thai or English education visa through a language course
facts.quote: A Thai or English education visa with Insight gives you the chance to learn a new language and stay in Thailand

facts.label: ED visa process
facts.value: School submits the application to the Ministry of Education
facts.quote: We submit your application to the Minsitry of Education.

facts.label: Thai courses
facts.value: Thai courses at the Silom and Hua Hin schools
facts.quote: Thai language courses are available at our Silom, Bangkok language school and our Hua Hin language school.

facts.label: Courses
facts.value: Academic, General Training and Life Skills IELTS courses
facts.quote: With Academic IELTS, General Training IELTS and IELTS Life Skills courses available

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Hua Hin branch in the center of Hua Hin on Petchkasem Road
facts.quote: Our Hua Hin language school is conveniently located in the center of Hua Hin on Petchkasame Road
